tests: Choosing the cheapest EC2 purchasing option for a fault-tolerant, interruptible batch job with a flexible schedule.
expected: Spot Instances (up to ~90% discount). Triggers: "fault-tolerant", "stateless", "checkpoint and resume", "can be interrupted", "flexible schedule", "a few hours per night".
why_not: On-Demand is the most expensive per hour; 3-year Standard RI and 1-year Compute Savings Plan require a long-term commitment for a steady 24/7 baseline — overpaying for a few hours a day.
